(Japanese: '''伝説のポケモン''' ''Legendary Pokémon'') is the 57th chapter of the [[Pokémon RéBURST]] manga.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Ryouga]] attempts to take off with all six Burst Hearts to find [[Arcades]] but is stopped by his friends.
* [[Great Gavel]] captures {{p|Cobalion}}, {{p|Terrakion}} and {{p|Virizion}} by holding several Pokémon captive.
* With the three Pokémon captured, Gerubu states that it's time for three certain individuals to make their appearance.
